definition.prompt:
Build Fraction Slider as a native 232×168 v4 photo preview and a separate complete 440×380 full composition. Keep the original five bounded frames, shared selected index, all five direct indicators and Home/End keys; use the sliding indicator and number drum recipes. Shared dock actions: Previous, Next, Reset. Every transition retargets from the current painted state and Reset cancels stale work while retaining caller suspension. Reduced motion uses finite 150ms opacity feedback. Keep all original v4 photo sources and native SVG bytes/root dimensions/design slots, including the reference partial state on Reset. Use local verified 1600px photos for detail and 800px photos with licence comments for portable exports. No outer demo panel, private driver buttons, generated landscapes or screenshot artwork. All typography is neutral and at least 11px after fit. Pause scheduling/animations on document, viewport and caller holds; cleanup aborts all input and cancels every owned task.
Accessibility: The field name follows the actual current full caption, preserving its line-break word boundaries and archive copy; native names use the actual two-digit fraction. Keep all five frames and counter timings. Preserve all v4 copy, geometry, assets, datasets, clocks and motion recipes above.
Accessibility: In full view, use the Stage primary/secondary/tertiary ink tokens for transparent text and retain readable light ink on dark tooltips/selected wells. Keep exact native artwork, every geometry value, original copy, datasets, source clocks and interaction models.

definition.prompt: Build the v4 Letter Cascade menu from Figma 156:1839. Its hero has Work, Journal, About and Contact in Geist semibold 22px at stagex 136 and y 46,80,114,148. Journal starts selected; preserve the 8×2px orange tick at(118,92), grey siblings and exact resting geometry. Full mode retains the four original studio routes. Create individual glyph masks and a duplicate character at top 100%; active characters roll up 100% over 400ms ease-out with 40ms stagger capped around 300ms. Intentional hover/focus/press shifts the selected link 9px and dims siblings to.28 with 3px blur and a -5px shift; the initial hero is held at its clean Figma peak without those sibling effects. Share one selected index for pointer, focus, press, arrows/Home/End and shell Next link/Reset. Keep accessible link names independent of duplicate glyphs, prevent hash navigation and release focus/hover on Escape or leave. Hover applies only to fine pointers. Reduced motion preserves colour and 150ms opacity feedback without glyph travel, blur or looping. Use scoped classes, status telemetry and abortable listeners; no outer panel or developer annotations.

definition.title: Context Meter
definition.desc: A deterministic context-window gauge turns live token bursts into throughput, cumulative session cost, warning states and an inspectable compaction cycle.
definition.seen: Seen on: Jeet Nirnejak's Token Usage component
definition.hint: Ambient · The context bar fills by source as tokens arrive

definition.prompt: Build an original Context Meter in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, retaining the entire original 400 by 330 detail model. Use mulberry32 seed 42, 64 events and exactly 128 draws, alternating inclusive interval 1500 through 3000ms and inclusive amount 800 through 4000 tokens. Throughput is amount times 1000 divided by interval. Retain the 200000-token capacity, 41200 initial context, cost .00001 dollars per billed token, warning at .7 and critical at .9, 70000-token compacted context, last-30 throughput history and its complete original 150 by 58 path/domain 250 through 2700 with 5px padding. The actual ring is the original 120px SVG, radius52/stroke8/pathLength100. Preserve its 600ms bound update, 300ms spark shift, 250ms cost tween and 1200ms compaction with the original pulse and bound curve. Critical compaction reduces context without reducing billed session cost. Preserve the eight-trigger queue, overflow/rejection rules, Escape clearing it, End materializing event57 then the critical event58, and Home/R reset. Keep dynamic whole-dollar digit allocation through at least $100.003 at canonical event4159, including decimal position and significant leading zero rules. Animate only changed cost digits with 250ms ease-out: old up4px/blur2px and new from below; unchanged digit DOM remains stable. Add a neutral segmented context-by-source bar: initial conversation/files/tools allocation 20600/12360/8240, event source index modulo3, proportional retention on compaction. All original event fixtures and checksums must remain unchanged. Shared actions are Add response, Pause/run and Reset; the full meter also accepts native Enter/Space/Right Arrow. The separate 224 by 168 v4 preview has Context/68% at local22,54, a 180 by6 track at local22,80, source segment widths62/40/20 at offsets0/64/106, and the exact three original6px source SVGs at local22/80/138,100. The three neutral swatches are34 by5. Preserve native source glyph bytes/dimensions and Figma geometry. Preview bursts use the complete seeded64-event fixture and a finite500ms eased progress update; reduced motion advances deliberately. Use local Inter, Geist Mono for percentage metadata, neutral greys and one orange source; keep all visible text at least11px after fitting. Honor virtual time, pause all owned number animations, and clean up observers, listeners and frames on disposal. Accessibility: expose the component-local content without document-level landmarks; use valid named control roles and the complete list, row and cell ownership for this composition. Preserve all visible copy, native geometry, supplied assets, datasets, interaction models and motion recipes. Keep contextual labels on appropriate named groups while preserving all artwork, displayed copy, datasets, models and controls.
